posts.text: It was great to celebrate Juneteenth with folks across the valley, including at the fifth annual @AZHistSociety Juneteenth celebration. Today, we celebrate the resilience of the Black community and recognize when the last enslaved African Americans learned of their freedom in 1865. Despite its significance, Juneteenth only recently became a federal holiday. I was proud to support the legislation that made that possible.
